emily-cust: Quick presales question: we need BYOK via our CloudHSM, automatic KEK rotation every 4h, and immutable per-key audit lines for auditors. Can Redwood prove <15ms p50 in a POC?
ben-sales: yes, we'll run a 3-week POC. We'll validate latency, unwrap ops, and provide attestation artifacts.
raj-se: two POC options: (1) sidecar key-proxy with short in-memory TTL (best latency), (2) direct KMS unwrap per session (strongest security). We'll test both.
raj-se: sample sidecar knobs we'll exercise: cache_ttl=45s, max_cached_keys=8, mem_lock=true, rotation cron "0 */4 * * *".
tessa-sec: auditors need HSM attestation PDF, signed proof-of-possession, and per-op logs (event, key_id, ts, principal). We'll supply schema and sample files for SIEM ingestion.
emily-cust: paste one sample audit line we can ingest?
raj-se: sample single-line JSON: {"ts":"2026-12-01T12:02:03Z","event":"unwrap","key_id":"custX/prod/kek-01","req_id":"r_7788","principal":"svc/match"}
ben-sales: POC plan: kickoff & FW/attest exchange, deploy sidecar in staging + baseline perf, rotation stress (4h cadence x72h), deliver logs & cost projection, go/no-go.
ben-sales: action items: @raj-se perf harness + unwrap metrics, @tessa-sec attach attestation + log schema, @emily-cust confirm peak QPS and FIPS requirement.
deploy-bot: deploy-status: key-proxy v1.2 rolled to stg-5 at 2026-12-01T12:10:00Z :rocket:
emily-cust: thanks 10; if POC shows sidecar with cache_ttl=45s meets latency + audit needs, we'll sign SOW.
